newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar finishes up, but off highs.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar finishes up, but off highs.

text.p: White sugar futures ended firmer but off the day's highs on Tuesday, following the trend set by New York raws.
Commission house activity accounted for most of the day's turnover of 2,347 lots.
October rallied to a high of $328.00, battling scale sellers along the way, but then slipped back to end just $0.60 firmer at $327.00.
In New York, the October contract was little changed at 11.84 cents after coming off a fund-led rally which drove October raws to a fresh contract high of 12.00 cents/lb.
Producer pricing had pared gains and pushed the New York market back into its recent trading range.
